description: This file defines data models and related functions for 'Board' entities in a project, including types, constants, structs, JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, and patching logic.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a collection of blocks and layout with properties, identifiers, and metadata.

classes.name: BoardPatch
classes.description: Used to modify existing Board instances with optional fields.

classes.name: BoardMember
classes.description: Stores user membership information on a board, including roles and admin/editor/commenter/viewer flags.

classes.name: BoardMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata such as descendant update times and creator/modifier IDs for a Board.

classes.name: BoardMemberHistoryEntry
classes.description: Tracks history entries of user membership actions on a board, including timestamps.

classes.name: InvalidBoardErr
classes.description: Custom error type for invalid board validation errors.

methods.name: GetPropertyString
methods.description: Returns the string value of a specified property or an error if not found or invalid type.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a BoardPatch to a Board, updating fields and properties accordingly.

methods.name: IsBoardTypeValid
methods.description: Checks if a BoardType is valid (either 'O' or 'P').

methods.name: IsBoardMinimumRoleValid
methods.description: Checks if a BoardRole is valid among predefined roles.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Board's essential fields and types.

methods.name: BoardSearchFieldFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a BoardSearchField enum value, or returns an error if invalid.
